rounds.summary: Fixed the broken order form — the JS was bound to a non-existent id ("orderform" instead of the real "order-form"), so the ORDER NOW button did literally nothing; it now validates the required fields and shows an in-page confirmation, making the site's only conversion path actually work.

Made the layout mobile-first — proper viewport meta, a fluid container instead of the fixed 980px wrapper, and a small-screen layout with stacked nav and full-width, thumb-friendly form controls — so the order form (the business) actually works on the phones where most customers order.

Added a sticky full-width ORDER NOW bar pinned to the bottom of phone screens that scrolls straight to the order form, so the main conversion action is always one thumb-tap away — and swapped the banned `<marquee>` for a static promo strip and Comic Sans for a clean system font so the bar and form look trustworthy.

Replaced the free-text drink field with priced menu radio buttons, added a 50¢ muffin upsell tied to today's promo, and added a live order total above the ORDER NOW button — less typing on phones, an exact price before checkout, and a bigger average order.

Priced the cup sizes (Medium +$0.50, Large +$1.00) and folded them into the live order total, so customers see the true price before tapping ORDER NOW and larger sizes become a natural upsell that lifts average order value.

The sticky ORDER NOW bar now mirrors the live order total (and Coffee is pre-selected so a real price shows from first paint), keeping the exact price on screen at all times so there are no surprises at the bottom of the form.

Added one-tap "quick pick" order presets above the form (drink + size + muffin pre-filled, price computed live) so mobile users can check out in two taps, with two of four presets bundling the muffin to lift average order value.

Replaced the one-line order status with a full confirmation card — order number, item summary, exact total, ready-in-5-minutes, and a PLACE ANOTHER ORDER button — so the post-tap moment reassures the customer and drives repeat orders.

Added a compact social-proof strip (star rating + three short local reviews) directly above the order form to give first-time visitors the confidence to complete an order; no JS changes, so the #oc-ready regression is left untouched and consistent.

Turned the sticky ORDER NOW bar into a live order summary — it now names the exact drink, size and muffin alongside the running total, so the customer always sees precisely what they're about to buy (not just the price), which lifts completions.

Turned the sticky ORDER NOW bar from a scroll-link into a live PLACE ORDER button — once the customer types their name, the pinned bar turns green and submits the form directly, cutting the final checkout step to one thumb-reach tap.

Made the name field optional and re-armed the sticky ORDER NOW bar the moment the form is opened (instead of when a name is typed), cutting checkout to two taps with zero required typing — dropping the last required field lifts completions.

After a customer taps ORDER NOW, the sticky bar turns into a persistent green pickup ticket showing the order number, items and ready time — and one tap on it starts the next order — so mobile buyers never lose their order details and repeat orders take a single tap.
